svg.title: By Theorem 9.2 the same envelope holds for R ◦P ◦π on Z in raw directions of the same norm, and by Proposition 9.1 the hypothesis chord(P(U)) ≤θ is the same event for raw links. The curvature coordinate is covariant, c(π(r, A)p) = Adr−1 x c(Ap), and f and Q4 are adjoint invariant by (SQ5), so R(π(r, A)p) = R(Ap): the startup residual is a frame-blind function and its Taylor data are recovered exactly. The inverse curvature coordinate itself is not frame-blind; only the invariant functions built from it are read out. The quartic form Q4 and its coefficient are determined by the Wilson price through (SQ1)–(SQ4); they are computed, not chosen.
